name: singleplayer-harness
description: Emulator harnesses for the single-player game family. NOT a build unit: functions/ and frontend/ each have their own package.json and are what get deployed. This root package exists solely to hold the browser driver the .mjs harnesses use. ⚠ THE FORECAST HARNESSES BUILD functions/ FIRST. emulators:exec serves functions/lib, so without it a harness silently runs the PREVIOUS compile and reports a green suite for code that was never executed — which happened, 08-03. The other games' scripts predate this and still assume the caller built.

scripts.harness:pd: firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --project demo-singleplayer --config firebase.json "node pd-playthrough.mjs"
scripts.harness:pennies: firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --project demo-singleplayer --config firebase.json "node pennies-playthrough.mjs"
scripts.harness:poll: firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --project demo-singleplayer --config firebase.json "node poll-playthrough.mjs"
scripts.harness:pricing: firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --project demo-singleplayer --config firebase.json "node pricing-playthrough.mjs"
scripts.harness:newsvendor: firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --project demo-singleplayer --config firebase.json "node newsvendor-playthrough.mjs"
scripts.harness:forecast: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --project demo-singleplayer --config firebase.json "node forecast-playthrough.mjs"
scripts.harness:forecast:browser: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --project demo-singleplayer --config firebase.json "node forecast-playwright.mjs"
scripts.harness:newsvendor:browser: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --project demo-singleplayer --config firebase.json "node newsvendor-playwright.mjs"
scripts.harness:pd:browser: firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --project demo-singleplayer --config firebase.json "node pd-playwright.mjs"
scripts.harness:pricing:browser: firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --project demo-singleplayer --config firebase.json "node pricing-playwright.mjs"
scripts.repro:pd:student-session: firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --project demo-singleplayer --config firebase.json "node pd-student-session-repro.mjs"
scripts.robots:forecast:dryrun: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --project demo-singleplayer --config firebase.json "node forecast-robot-dryrun.mjs"
